leadText:
-----
 
Pokémon Shorts is a series of 12 - shorts made to promote . The first one debuted on Twitter on November 22, 2016. The other seven were made available daily from November 24 to 30, 2016. Four of them were later posted on The Pokémon Company International's YouTube channel for Pokémon Day 2017. The series was also posted on from December 18 to 26, 2016. Four more shorts were released monthly from March 9 to June 16, 2021 for the Pokémon 25th Anniversary.
